output.reason: The evidence shows (a) the loan agreement states that a pre-payment charge is payable in the event of pre-payment/foreclosure (“2%” in one clause and “3%” in another), and (b) UCB directions state that a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on certain floating rate loans for business purposes to individuals/MSMEs with sanctioned limit up to ₹50 lakh (for loans sanctioned/renewed on or after Jan 1, 2026).
